title: Brightwater Lake
wikitext:
[[image:Brightwater_Lake.jpg|thumb|Brightwater Lake]]
'''Brightwater Lake''' is the biggest lake in [[Tirisfal Glades]]. Before the [[Plague of Undeath]] struck the land, this lake was a popular site for recreation like bathing and fishing. Now it lies dark and silent, dead trees floating along the edge and rotting on the bottom. [[Gunther's Retreat]], mostly inhabited by mindless [[Scourge]] zombies, is situated on the lake's largest island.
